evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen from 28764.1 ppm at 120 s to 13.1 ppm.
Growth temperature settled to 749.6 °C after a transient 759.6 °C reading at 2520 s, with a 750 °C setpoint.
Temperature is stable at 750.3 °C against a 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 43.4%.
Argon is 99.6 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint, pressure remains stable at 2.906 Torr, and oxygen is low at 3.7 ppm.
